name: Ugreen Group Ltd
summary: Ugreen Group Ltd. (symbol: 301606.SZ) is a global enterprise engaged in the entire lifecycle of consumer electronic products, from research and development to design, production, and sales, serving markets in China and worldwide. The company offers a diverse product portfolio, including: Electronic storage solutions: Such as hard drives, cloud storage devices, hard disk expansion cards, drive enclosures, and adapter cables. Bluetooth earphones. Mobile phone peripherals: A wide array of accessories including USB Type-C, MFi-certified Apple, and Android data cables, OTG series products, phone holders, and protective items like tempered glass and mobile phone cases. Smart charging products: Featuring PD fast charging, portable power banks, USB chargers (including QC2.0/3.0 fast charging), wireless chargers, and smart sockets. Apple peripherals: Dedicated accessories designed for Apple devices. Computer peripherals: Encompassing docking stations, input devices (keyboards and mice), USB extensions, USB HUBs, external network cards, external graphics cards, card readers, Bluetooth adapters, and network industrial control products. Automotive peripherals. Audio and video equipment. Lifestyle devices. Established in 2012, Ugreen Group Ltd. is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
